---
name: Objection
about: Challenge a proposal with a specific, checkable objection
title: "[Objection] CP-XX: "
assignees: ""
---

## Proposal

Which proposal and version? (For example: `CP-01`, Draft v0.1.)

## Exact location

Quote the sentence, formula, or table row you are objecting to. Include the section
number.

## Objection

What is wrong? Be specific. "I disagree" is not an objection; "the formula double
counts the spill" is.

## Evidence

Link to a primary source, a derivation, or a test. Label it `[OFFICIAL]`,
`[DERIVED]`, or `[ASSUMPTION]`.

## What would change your mind

State the observation or argument that would resolve the objection.

## Conflict of interest

Disclose any relevant affiliation. Write "none" if none.

---

Do not include personal data, wallet addresses, private keys, or seed phrases.
